rows.asIs: Read-only Notes bridge filters Soup documents. Native NotesPage uses a separate store.
rows.toBe: Document actions (open/edit) go through native Notes + Rox2Result. Conation is a source adapter, not an iframe.

rows.asIs: Soup chat type exists on the GraphQL contract. Rox sessions are native transcripts.
rows.toBe: Do not dual-write chats. Map Conation chat ids as relations onto native sessions when a user links them.

rows.asIs: Soup project type exists. Rox ProjectInfoPage is a separate native model.
rows.toBe: Project list/read from Soup is an adapter behind native projects RPC.

rows.asIs: No native Mail surface. Mail is not a first-class entity in Rox UI.
rows.toBe: Native mail-thread entity + list/read actions with cloud-send permission. No iframe.

rows.asIs: Soup channel type exists. Messaging settings are Rox-native, not Conation channels.
rows.toBe: Channel entities in the unified model; posting requires permission.
Messages are events on a channel entity, not a second inbox UI.
Optional call entity in the model. Do not ship a fake in-app dialer.

rows.asIs: Calendar package is native. Soup events are not merged into it.
rows.toBe: Merge adapters into packages/core/src/calendar without replacing native store.
CRM company as a native entity list (entity-list), actions behind permission.

rows.asIs: Opaque foreign entity on Soup. Rox sources are MCP/connections.
rows.toBe: Map foreign entities onto source/connection refs; do not invent a third catalog.
Reminder entity + calendar relation. Creating one is a live write with permission.

rows.asIs: Read-only DSS client. Flags default off. No native Drive browser.
rows.toBe: File entities from DSS list/read. Writes and FileProvider stay blocked until signing exists.

rows.asIs: ConationBoardPanel opens Conation via deep link. Copy says there is no second kanban.
rows.toBe: Keep a single native KanbanBoard. Conation Board is a source of task entities, not a pane iframe.

rows.asIs: Fund pane is a deep link. Interactive canvas disabled pending perf proof.
rows.toBe: Native mindmap/pages remain the canvas. Fund is an adapter or stays a documented external open.

rows.asIs: workbench.conation.* flags default false. Visibility is not background sync.
rows.toBe: Keep defaults off for network clients. Native entity features stay available without Conation.
